column1: # Source ownership of the ddd-agents developer skills. One rule per line: <glob><TAB><skill id>.
# First match wins. '**/' = zero or more path segments, '**' at the end = anything, '*' = anything but '/'.
# The groups are ordered so that every named exception stands above the folder pattern it pierces: the skills whose
# classes sit inside mixed folders come first, the loop (the default of the mixed loop folders) comes last.
# observability (ddd-module-agents-observability-specialist): watch, debug, record and replay, evaluate a run
# decisions-and-guards (ddd-module-agents-decisions-and-guards-specialist): decision layer, owner consent, injection screening
# autonomy (ddd-module-agents-autonomy-specialist): delegation, schedules, eligibility, mandates, supervisor, owner reports, background operations
# widgets (ddd-module-agents-widgets-specialist): widgets, composed views, signal sources, activity lines, realtime signal, external agents
# skills-and-purposes (ddd-module-agents-skills-and-purposes-specialist): agent skills, catalog, loading, purposes, done criteria, variants, progress
# context (ddd-module-agents-context-specialist): model input, prompts, cache, reduction, eviction, state delivery, recall, memories, presence and time
# tools (ddd-module-agents-tools-specialist): MCP tool layer, attributes, DTOs, executor, dispatch and execution, batches, meta-tool contract
# entry (ddd-module-agents-specialist): install, wire and run; spaces, entitlements, scopes, rights, environments, channels, transports, listeners, API
# loop (ddd-module-agents-loop-specialist): a turn from the owner's message to the answer; the default of the mixed loop folders
